WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'P5' AS basis, SUM(net_sales) AS net, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS web, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales END) AS stores FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Sep', SUM(net_sales), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales END), SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales END) FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS n FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales AS c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-30')
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) AS store_id, COUNT(*) AS days, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(n,0)),2) AS mine, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(c,0)),2) AS ctl, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(n,0)-COALESCE(c,0)),2) AS diff,
 SUM(CASE WHEN abs(COALESCE(n,0)-COALESCE(c,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.business_date=c.business_date AND m.store_id=c.store_id
GROUP BY 1 HAVING abs(SUM(COALESCE(n,0)-COALESCE(c,0)))>0.01 OR SUM(CASE WHEN abs(COALESCE(n,0)-COALESCE(c,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 ORDER BY 1

FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
